channel.title: EndlessTech Blog
channel.description: Practical Microsoft 365 security guides, Zero Trust strategies, and Intune tips for SMBs. By Philipp Schmidt.

item.title: Unused Enterprise Apps: Why Last Sign-In Lies
item.description: An Entra app with zero user sign-ins can still read every mailbox every night. How to separate delegated logins from app-only data flows before you clean up.

item.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Plans, Features, and a Sane SMB Setup
item.description: EOP vs Defender Plan 1 vs Plan 2 explained without the licensing fog, plus the preset policy setup that stops most phishing in a Microsoft 365 tenant you already pay for.

item.title: M365 Tenant Enumeration: The Identity Leak Microsoft Won't Fully Close
item.description: M365 tenant enumeration lets an unauthenticated attacker confirm which accounts exist before ever guessing a password. The technical vectors, why Microsoft can't fully fix it, and how to make the leak useless.

item.title: Zero Trust for Microsoft 365, Part 4: Securing Data
item.description: Data is the fourth Zero Trust pillar for Microsoft 365 and the one the other three exist to protect. How Purview sensitivity labels, DLP, and auto-labeling keep data protected wherever it moves.

item.title: Zero Trust for Microsoft 365, Part 3: Securing Apps
item.description: Apps are the third Zero Trust pillar for Microsoft 365. How Defender for Cloud Apps, OAuth governance, and Conditional Access App Control bring shadow IT and SaaS under control.

item.title: Zero Trust for Microsoft 365, Part 2: Securing Devices
item.description: Devices are the second Zero Trust pillar for Microsoft 365. How Intune compliance, security baselines, Autopilot, and Defender for Endpoint turn every device into a policy enforcement point.

item.title: Zero Trust for Microsoft 365, Part 1: Securing Identity
item.description: Identity is the first pillar of Zero Trust for Microsoft 365 and the highest-impact category in Secure Score. How to secure it with MFA, Conditional Access, passwordless, and PIM.

item.title: Zero Trust for Microsoft 365: A New 4-Part Series, One Pillar at a Time
item.description: A new four-part series maps Zero Trust for Microsoft 365 to the four pillars Secure Score actually measures — Identity, Devices, Apps, and Data. Here is what each part covers.

item.title: Cloud API vs. Local AI Models: The Honest TCO and Security Analysis No One Wants to Write
item.description: Cloud AI APIs vs local models: the honest total cost of ownership and security analysis. Why utilization — not technology — decides the cost, and how local deployment shifts risk rather than removing it.

item.title: You Already Paid for This: Defender in M365-First Companies
item.description: Most M365-first companies pay for endpoint security they never switched on. Why the platform you already own beats adding another tool — a leadership perspective.

item.title: Optimize SharePoint Online Storage Before You Pay For It
item.description: SharePoint Online storage rarely grows because of new files. Version history, recycle bins, and the Preservation Hold Library do the damage. Here is how to reclaim it.

item.title: Microsoft 365 Security Best Practices
item.description: Essential security configurations and best practices to secure your Microsoft 365 tenant — mapping IT security, information security, and cybersecurity to Intune, Purview, and Defender XDR with practical Zero Trust implementation steps and NIST CSF 2.0 alignment.

item.title: Demystifying the Microsoft Graph API: A Practical Guide
item.description: A practical guide to the Microsoft Graph API for IT practitioners managing M365 tenants. Tools, authentication, query patterns, and real automation use cases.

item.title: AD CS ESC1: The Most Common Misconfiguration That Hands Attackers Domain Admin
item.description: AD CS ESC1 is one of the most common certificate template misconfigurations. In one incident I analysed it was the direct path from a standard user to Domain Admin in 180 minutes. How to audit and remediate ESC1.

item.title: Digital Sovereignty: Why Europe Lost the Cloud Race — And Why That's Okay
item.description: Europe lost the cloud race to the US — and that's okay. Why fear-driven calls for digital sovereignty fail, and what an asymmetric strategy looks like.

item.title: Is Microsoft Entra ID Free? Pricing Guide for Small Businesses
item.description: Is Microsoft Entra ID free? Yes — and here's exactly what the free tier includes, what paid plans cost, and when small businesses actually need to upgrade.

item.title: Your IT Security Is an Airport – And Everyone Is Sneaking Through the Emergency Exit
item.description: Zero Trust vs perimeter security, explained through an airport analogy — why "never trust, always verify" beats the old castle-and-moat model.

item.title: From Theory to Implementation: How Context Engineering Technically Works
item.description: From theory to implementation: Discover the technical reality behind a productive Context Engineering system. Learn how functional separation, prompt architecture, and clear ownership drive AI success.

item.title: Security by Obscurity is Dead — Build Real Defense in Depth
item.description: Security by Obscurity is a dangerous illusion. Learn how Defense in Depth, Least Privilege, and Zero Trust build real enterprise security with Microsoft 365.

item.title: Taming the SharePoint Permission Nightmare: The New Copilot Readiness Tool
item.description: SharePoint permission audit for Copilot readiness: use the Data Access Governance report to find overshared sites before Copilot surfaces them.

item.title: Microsoft 365 vs. Baramundi: The Real Story
item.description: Microsoft 365 vs Baramundi is the wrong comparison. One is a productivity platform, the other an on-prem UEM. Here is how they differ and coexist.

item.title: The Final Exchange Server: Why the Cloud Switch Isn't a Magic Wand
item.description: Microsoft's new Exchange SOA switch promises to let you shut down your last on-premises server. But edge cases like configuration drift can cause chaos.

item.title: Stop the Setup Chaos: How Windows Autopilot Deploys Hundreds of Devices Without Breaking a Sweat
item.description: How Windows Autopilot deployment works — v1 vs v2, user-driven vs self-deploying mode. Zero-touch device provisioning for SMEs, no IT touch required.

item.title: AADSTS650052: WindowsDefenderATP Service Principal Missing – Cause & Fix
item.description: Fix the AADSTS650052 error: WindowsDefenderATP Service Principal missing. Learn the cause, pitfalls with E5 Dev Tenants, and the PowerShell solution.

item.title: From NT to M365 – A Journey Through Tech, Decisions, and the People Behind Them
item.description: A personal reflection on 15+ years in IT consulting – from Windows NT and Active Directory to M365 and Zero Trust – and the moments that shaped the journey.

item.title: The Golden Tenant Is Dead. Here's What Replaces It.
item.description: The Intune golden tenant model breaks as soon as Microsoft ships the next update. Why drift-aware automation replaces static reference tenants for MSPs.

item.title: You Don't Have to Love Microsoft – But You Should Understand Its Dominance (Pragmatism Over Ideology)
item.description: Microsoft 365 isn't perfect, but it's unrivaled. Why its market position is earned, alternatives are mostly building blocks, and independent backups are key to resilience.

item.title: iOS/iPadOS ABM Enrollment Troubleshooting: The 'Not Contacted' Nightmare
item.description: Managing Apple devices with Intune? Here's why iOS/iPadOS devices show "Not Contacted" after ABM enrollment — the root cause and the factory-reset fix.

item.title: Intune Enrollment Restrictions: Your Foundational Control Against Local Admin Risk
item.description: Intune enrollment restrictions are your foundational Zero Trust control. How to block personal Windows devices and mitigate local admin risk.

item.title: Microsoft Entra Tenant vs. Azure Subscription: The Difference
item.description: Understand the fundamental differences between Microsoft Entra ID Tenants and Azure Subscriptions, and learn how they work together to manage identity and cloud resources.

item.title: The Copilot "Mandate" - A Fact-Check on Digital Sovereignty and Cloud Governance
item.description: A fact-check on the Swiss Parliament's Microsoft Copilot incident, exploring digital sovereignty, cloud governance, and the shared responsibility model in the AI era.

item.title: ZTNA with Microsoft Entra Suite: Zero Trust Network Access
item.description: How Microsoft Entra Suite enables Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) — Entra Private Access, Global Secure Access, and Conditional Access in one platform.

item.title: Windows 11 and Hardware Lifecycles: Why the Debate is Bigger Than Microsoft
item.description: The debate over Windows 11's hardware requirements isn't about an update; it's about the future of IT infrastructure and why a structured hardware lifecycle is a business necessity.

item.title: Microsoft 365 Add-Ons: Is Business Premium Worth It?
item.description: Why Microsoft 365 Business Premium is worth it for SMBs, and how the Microsoft Defender Suite for Business Premium and the Microsoft Purview Suite deliver enterprise-grade protection at a fraction of the cost.

item.title: MCP Servers Part 1: Understanding the Double-Edged Sword of AI Tooling
item.description: MCP servers security risks explained: prompt injection, RCE, supply chain attacks, and a four-layer defense strategy using Microsoft Defender and Entra ID.

item.title: Boost Your Cyber Defense: Microsoft Secure Score for SMBs
item.description: Microsoft Secure Score for SMBs: how to read the dashboard, which quick wins raise your score fastest, and realistic benchmarks for small businesses.

item.title: Windows 365 Cloud Apps: When Less is More
item.description: Windows 365 Cloud Apps revolutionize application delivery. Discover how targeted app streaming reduces costs and increases efficiency for SMEs.

item.title: Mobile Application Management: Your Quarterback for Mobile Security
item.description: Mobile Application Management (MAM) secures company data in apps on personal devices. How Intune app protection policies work — with or without enrollment.

item.title: Zero Trust with Microsoft 365: The Complete Pillar-by-Pillar Guide
item.description: Zero Trust in Microsoft 365 means never trust, always verify. A comprehensive guide to implementing Zero Trust across Microsoft's seven technology pillars — Identity, Endpoints, Data, Apps, Infrastructure, Network, and SecOps — with M365 as the control plane.
